## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `197aa7c88ecb765efa7827b07e42a1f3047a4eb2`
Local-runs: none
Scope: docs/adr/0055-master-detail-controlled-by-parent.md, skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md, skills/objectstack-data/references/lint-rules.md, skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md, skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md + content/docs/permissions/authorization.mdx, content/docs/permissions/rls.mdx, content/docs/permissions/sharing-rules.mdx, content/docs/permissions/permissions-matrix.mdx, content/docs/permissions/index.mdx, .changeset/data-skill-optional-master.md, skills/objectstack-data/evals/*.json; cited code, read on `origin/main` `51992dff6` (none of these paths moved since merge base `719a502b2`): packages/spec/src/data/controlled-by-parent-master.ts, packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts (`forceCbpMasterDetailRequired`, `refuseControlledByParentWithoutOneMaster`), packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-cbp-read-filter.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-cbp-write-gate.ts, packages/lint/src/data-model-rules.ts (`cbpMasterReferenceFinding`), packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.ts (`cbpMasterCandidates`), packages/lint/src/validate-membership-key-declarations.ts, packages/qa/scenarios/src/score/scenario-tags.ts, packages/spec/src/contracts/security-service.ts, packages/verify/src/parent-write-reach.ts, scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs, scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs, scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs; and the other `content/docs` pages that still teach a required-only master (error-handling.mdx, error-catalog.mdx, cli.mdx)

### ① Derived judgments

Inputs: card #30907 (body; the triage; the card-2 carry-over 6702057019; the unlock; the claim), sibling #30906 with PR #31082 (its body and its changeset `30906-cbp-null-master-write-gate.md`), the PR body, its 11-file list and the net diff against merge base `719a502b2`. Each taught fact was checked against the code on `main`:

- **Which `master_detail` may be `required: false`.** TRUE. `controlledByParentMasterOf`: exactly one `required: true` wins; otherwise the object's only `master_detail`, if it is `=== false`, is the optional master. Refused: `readonly`/`system` on the one master, required or optional (`master-not-writable`). An omitted `required` is forced to `true` by `ObjectSchema.create()` (`forceCbpMasterDetailRequired`). Two `master_detail` with none required is refused (`several-masters`). The skill's "Refused beside a second `master_detail`" is true at `create()`, which throws for `required: false` beside any other `master_detail`. That is the door the skill teaches. (A raw parse admits it beside a required master as an ordinary parent, and that is not the master. Not a finding.) The lint-rules row matches `cbpMasterReferenceFinding` (`soleMasterDetail && required === false` passes; flags still reported).
- **Who reads a null-master row.** TRUE. `computeControlledByParentFilter`: `nullMasterArm` is `{fk: null}` under `hasSuperuserReadBypass` (View All or Modify All on the detail). Otherwise it is `{fk: null} AND owner_id = caller` when `ownerColumn`, else no arm. The master arm is OR-ed beside it. Skill, rls.mdx, sharing-rules.mdx, permissions-matrix.mdx and SKILL.md all say "the owner and View All".
- **Who writes one.** TRUE. `nullMasterRowWritable` admits `hasSuperuserWriteBypass` (Modify All), else `owner_id` non-null and equal to the caller. With no owner column, Modify All only. View All alone is refused (`nullMasterOwnerDenied`, leg `master_chain`).
- **An insert naming no master is admitted.** TRUE. `if (masterId == null && rel.optional) { if (operation === 'insert') return; …`. Batch rows that do name a master are still asked.
- **Emptying a master asks edit on the stored master, and `ownerMayEdit` does not cover it.** TRUE in code. `masterId` is the stored master, so the §3 walk asks edit on it. The owner leg carries `!(rel.optional && bodyEmptiesMasterReference(opCtx.data, rel.fk))`, and `askBodyNamedMaster` lets an optional master's `null` through. The ADR amendment, the PR body and the changeset all state it plainly. ⛔ **must-fix M1, `rules/relationships.md` § Optional master:** "emptying one asks edit on the stored master, `ownerMayEdit` aside." Read in the usual sense of "X aside" ("apart from X"), this makes `ownerMayEdit` an exception, so an opted-in owner would be able to empty with only read on the master. That is false, and it inverts the one fact card 2 pinned with its own ablation (A2). This file is what authors and agents read, so the sentence must say it directly. Suggested: "…asks edit on the stored master, even under `ownerMayEdit`." That is about +1 token, and the file has 8 of headroom.
- **Chain hop.** TRUE. `assertControlledByParentChainEditable`: `nextMasterId == null && nextRel.optional`, then `nullMasterRowWritable` on the master's own object, else `master_chain`. "Ends there under the same rule" is accurate.
- **Membership-key line.** TRUE. `columnOf` maps `id` to an empty `meta` slice, so `valueFieldFault` reports a non-reference and the rule is `membership-key-value-field-invalid`.
- **authorization.mdx lint bullet.** TRUE against `cbpMasterCandidates`: required masters first; with none, the spec's optional master. `no-relation` covers none, two none-required, an omitted `required`, and a required `lookup`. `ambiguous-relation` covers two or more required.
- **ADR-0055 §3 amendment against what card 2 shipped.** It matches the #31082 body and changeset point for point: the owner rule, insert, by-id and predicate writes, setting (owner rule then edit on the new master), emptying (the §3 walk, opt-in excluded), chains, on-behalf-of (each pass its own principal), `checkControlledByParentWrite` answering `allow`/`deny` on `master_chain` (never `unresolvable`), proof via `parent-write-reach.ts` `masters: 'none'` (present on `main`), and a required master unchanged (`422`). It does not overclaim the chain-hop proof (plugin-security suite only, per #31082).
- **In-place marks.** They are honest. Each of the four 2026-11-06 sentences (the status line; Ruling "amended again for §3 then"; Fail-closed "the write gate is unchanged"; What is unchanged "§3, the chain walk") keeps its original text byte for byte, with a dated ⚠️ note appended. The §3 rule line gains a second ⚠️ note beside the 2026-10-26 one. No history is rewritten.
- **The five docs pages.** They agree with the code and with each other (owner + View All reads; owner + Modify All writes). index.mdx's comment cites "ADR-0055 §1" for ownership. It is loose (the owner rule is §2/§3) but not false.
- **Deleted restatements.** All 11 were checked against their named homes, and each home carries the fact. relationships.md: the intro line repeats the H1 and ToC. The Delete Behaviors fence is covered by "`cascade` or `restrict` **only**; an authored `set_null` is refused". "Never summed on the client" is covered by "**server-side**". "Pairs naturally…" is covered by "inside the same transaction" plus Inline Editing's "one atomic transaction". "No form-view config…" and "primary, zero-config path" are covered by "on the relationship, in the data model — not in a form view". The ❌ comment is covered by the fence's own comment. The ✅ fence is the same object as the § One-to-Many: master_detail fence (`invoice_line_item`, required, cascade). security.md: the RLS comments are covered by the `using`/`check` prose directly above. "Rather than on a person or a position" is covered by the "Choose by what the rows are keyed on" list. SKILL.md: the dropped link is the Quick Reference L42 link. No unique fact is lost.
- **Scorer (read-only).** `scenario-tags.ts` L393 accepts any `def.sharingModel === 'controlled_by_parent'` without reading `required`, so no change is needed. That is correct.
- **should-fix S1, `rules/relationships.md` § Owner edits:** "every write needs edit access on the master" and "insert … still need master edit" now contradict the next subsection for a row that names no optional master (an insert is admitted; the owner rule governs). Qualify them, e.g. "of a row that names its master". Token headroom is tight; a same-file restatement deletion can pay for it.
- **should-fix S2, ADR-0055 2026-11-07 amendment, owner-rule bullet:** "Everyone else, View All included, is refused `403`" is the gate's verdict. A principal who cannot read the row meets the read door's `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND` at step 2.7 first (pinned in #31082). Narrow it to "everyone else who reaches the gate" or add the 404.

### ② Semver level

`'@objectstack/skills': patch` is right. Only skill prose ships (`packages/skills` is the published package, in the `fixed` group); `content/docs` and `docs/adr` do not publish, and the platform behaviour shipped in #30940/#31082. This matches the triage's prescription and the precedent for skill-text changesets. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` are right (no schema, contract or metadata meaning moves), and they are line-initial in both the PR body and the changeset.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Diff against the claim.** The diff stays inside the claim: the four data-skill files, the five permissions pages, ADR-0055 and one changeset. No eval file changed, the ratchet file is unchanged against `main`, and `packages/spec` is untouched (`security-service.ts` included).
- **Additional sentences in the 2026-11-06 amendment.** They are within "the ADR". The claim's parenthetical names only the header line, but they are the same file, and carry-over item 1 names those body sentences ("still says §3 is unchanged and 'is amended again for §3 then'"). All edits are append-only marks.
- **Tier.** `check-governed-merges` `GOVERNED_SURFACES`: `skills/**` (row `skills-catalog`) and `docs/adr/**` (row `adr`) are `GOVERNED_TIER_H`. One Tier H path makes the whole PR Tier H. Landing needs a human merge or an approval from `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` (`os-zhuang`, `hotlong`). The PR body says so, and `mergeable_state` is `blocked`.
- **Spec jsdoc owed in the PR body.** The wording is accurate against `security-service.ts` on `main`. L342–348 `master_chain` omits the record-itself null-master refusal and the optional hop. L377–378 `master_reference_missing` should say "required". L1064–1065 `checkControlledByParentWrite` should name the owner/Modify All alternative. Each matches the gate (`nullMasterOwnerDenied` → `master_chain`; `MasterReferenceMissingError` is only reached for a required master).
- **should-fix S3, the other-docs list in the PR body is incomplete:**
  - `error-handling.mdx` L286, 559–562 and 590–596, `error-catalog.mdx` 189–196, 214–216 and 1014, and `cli.mdx` L2142 are correct as listed.
  - Missing: `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` L2707–2711. The `--parent-write-reach` paragraph says a write is "admitted exactly when the caller holds that verb … **and** can edit its master", but verify now also proves null-master rows by the owner rule.
  - Missing: `content/docs/protocol/kernel/error-handling.mdx` L568–577. The declaration table lists required shapes only, and "Only the first row is a declaration the parse accepts" no longer holds: `required: false` on the sole `master_detail` is accepted, and emptying it is admitted under the owner rule.
  - Add both to the list and to the follow-up.
- **should-fix S4, carry-over item 2.** The claim says the seat files the spec-lane card for the `security-service.ts` jsdoc, but no such card is linked on #30907's thread. File it and link it from the card or the PR before merge, so the owed wording does not get lost.

### ④ Design judgment

- **One home per rule.** Yes. The optional master has one home, `rules/relationships.md` § Optional master. security.md's chooser line, SKILL.md's OWD row and lint-rules.md's row point to it or summarise it in one clause. The ADR keeps the mechanism and the docs pages carry one-line summaries.
- **Token budget.** `ceil(bytes/4)`, SKILL.md version line excluded, ceilings read from `check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` on `main`, no row raised:

| File | main | head | ceiling |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|
| SKILL.md | 6078 | 6071 | 6078 |
| security.md | 3688 | 3696 | 3698 |
| relationships.md | 3838 | 3865 | 3873 |
| lint-rules.md | 935 | 958 | 970 |

  All four are within ceiling; the readings match the PR body.
- **Eval sweep.** No case pins a required master for the optional-master scenario, and none pins a copied owner field. `objects-fields-relationships.json` #2 keeps `required: true` on an invoice line (right: a line always has its invoice), and its "every other write still needs master edit" is true for a required master. `hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json` #1 is a search mirror, not an owner copy, and #6 (membership keys, "no owner stamp per order") is still right.
- **Against the card's scenario.** "A rep sees the contacts of the accounts they own; a contact need not have an account" is taught as `account: { type: 'master_detail', reference: 'account', required: false }` on a `controlled_by_parent` contact. That is what `main` admits and serves. It is sound apart from M1's wording.
- **Check-runs on this head**, read 2026-11-07T06:23Z: 43 runs, 29 success, 12 skipped, 0 failed. Test Core (1/8) and Test Core (2/8) are still in progress.

Must-fix: M1. Should-fix: S1, S2, S3, S4.

It then takes `assertControlledByParentChainEditable` on the stored `masterId`, which is edit on the master. The ambiguous reading is gone.

This holds for every principal class, which is the "as for every hidden row" the sentence claims. A principal whose read of the whole object is refused gets that refusal instead, and a predicate write never selects a row its caller cannot read. The sentence speaks of "the row", an addressed row, so neither case makes it false. Not a finding.
